title: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. Tit. 22 § 205.9 - Miscellaneous proceedings
body:
All proceedings for which the procedure has
					 not been prescribed by provisions of the Family Court Act, the Domestic
					 Relations Law or the Social Services Law, including but not limited to,
					 proceedings involving consent to marry, interstate compact on juveniles and
					 material witnesses, shall be commenced by the filing of a petition and shall
					 require the entry of a written order.
